routes.description: List of domain-to-host routing entries for outbound ESMTP mail delivery.

domain.description: Destination domain (e.g., example.com) — must be a valid domain or subdomain.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the target SMTP server to which mail for the domain should be routed.

port.description: TCP port on the target host (typically 25 for ESMTP). Omit or set to 25 to use default.

flags.description: Optional comma-separated flags (e.g., 'verify', 'preauth', 'tls') — consult Courier docs for supported flags.
